name: Psychological Thriller & Locked Room Twist
description: Mind-bending suspense, high tension, ticking clock, unreliable narrators, and shocking closing revelations.
tone: suspenseful, eerie, fast-paced, intellectual clash, dark
target_audience: Mystery thriller enthusiasts, death game / crime anime viewers
visual_style: Moody desaturated palette, rain-streaked windows, flashing sirens, intense close-ups of eyes, shadowed figures

character_archetypes.protagonist: Cerebral detective or trapped victim unraveling a puzzle
character_archetypes.deuteragonist: Enigmatic partner whose loyalties remain deeply ambiguous
character_archetypes.antagonist: Mastermind orchestrating events from the shadows

narrative_formula: Hook: A gruesome or impossible puzzle discovered under a strict countdown.
Clue Discovery: Uncovering an inconsistency in witness testimony or room layout.
The Trap: Protagonist is cornered; looks like checkmate.
The Intellectual Reversal: Revealing that the protagonist foresaw the trap all along.
Twist Ending: The true culprit was someone hiding in plain sight.
